label: Stress relief: profligate
summary: Picks an event for a character who used the Profligate stress-relief decision.
details: Script fires it, not the game's code, and it runs on a character. Vanilla's stress_loss_profligate_decision names it as an on_action to fire. It holds one event of the stress_trait_coping_decisions group (4001), so that event is the only outcome.

label: Stress relief: rakish
summary: Picks an event for a character who used the Rakish stress-relief decision.
details: Script fires it and it runs on a character. Vanilla's stress_loss_rakish_decision names it as an on_action to fire. It has two events of the stress_trait_coping_decisions group: 2001 with weight 100 and 2002 with weight 5, so the second one is rare.

label: Stress relief: reclusive
summary: Picks an event for a character who used the Reclusive stress-relief decision.
details: Script fires it and it runs on a character. Vanilla's stress_loss_reclusive_decision names it as an on_action to fire. It holds a single event of the stress_trait_coping_decisions group (2501).

label: Stress pulse
summary: An empty hook in the stress system that vanilla defines but fills with nothing.
details: Script fires it, and it has no scope to start from. Mods can add effects or events to it, but the input does not show when the game fires it, so the timing is not known.

label: Stress level 1 event
summary: Picks a random event for a character at the first stress threshold level.
details: Script fires it and it runs on a character. Vanilla's comment calls it a stress threshold event tombola. It lists twelve events of the stress_threshold group (about guilt, desires, toil, being too busy, impostor syndrome and similar), ten at weight 100 and two generic ones at weight 10.

label: Stress level 1 event (prison)
summary: Picks a random event for an imprisoned character at the first stress threshold level.
details: It only runs if the character is imprisoned; otherwise nothing happens. Vanilla lists six events of the stress_threshold_prison group, all with equal weight. By its name it is the prison version of the plain level 1 on_action.

label: Stress level 2 event
summary: Picks a random event for a character at the second stress threshold level.
details: Script fires it and it runs on a character. Vanilla lists ten events of the stress_threshold group: three generic ones at weight 10, six personal ones at weight 100, and one at weight 10 that the comment says is for the player only.

label: Stress level 2 event (prison)
summary: Picks a random event for an imprisoned character at the second stress threshold level.
details: It only runs if the character is imprisoned. Vanilla lists four events: stress_threshold_prison.1001 at weight 50 (the same event the level 1 prison list has) and three events 2001, 2011 and 2021 at weight 100.

label: Stress level 3 event
summary: Picks a random event for a character at the third stress threshold level.
details: Script fires it and it runs on a character. Vanilla lists seven events of the stress_threshold group, all at weight 100: three generic ones, one commented as death, and three personal ones (punishing a messenger, feeling unworthy, a debauched domain).

label: Stress level 3 event (prison)
summary: Picks a random event for an imprisoned character at the third stress threshold level.
details: It only runs if the character is imprisoned. Vanilla lists four events: stress_threshold_prison.1001 at a low weight of 10 (the same event the level 1 prison list has) and three events 3001, 3011 and 3999 at weight 100.

label: Study Confucian classics failed
summary: Picks an event for a character after a Study Confucian Classics scheme failed.
details: Script fires it and it runs on a character. Vanilla lists nine events of the study_confucian_classics_outcome group: a small stress toast, skill gains, a scolding parent, a helpful elder or partner, and choices such as double-down on studying or praying. Two of them have double weight.

label: Study Confucian classics succeeded
summary: Picks a reward event for a character after a Study Confucian Classics scheme succeeded.
details: Script fires it and it runs on a character. Vanilla lists fifteen events of the study_confucian_classics_outcome group: small toasts, an exam advantage, becoming or levelling up as a poet, Confucian education, skill gains, merit, losing the Burdened state, and trading influence for benefits. Three have weight 300, so they are the likeliest.

label: Study faith: phase fell short
summary: Handles a Study Faith scheme phase that came in below the success chance, which vanilla's comment still counts as a slower, minor success.
details: Script fires it and it runs on a character. It calls the notify-puppeteer effect with a neutral toast. If the character has the pending_conversion_to_liege variable and has nothing left to learn from the target's rite, it fires event study_faith_outcome.0100 after 2 days. It then picks one of four events (weight 100 each): learn a tenet, learn a doctrine, nothing left to learn (ends the scheme), or the event for someone who was asked to convert and wanted to study first.

label: Study faith: ongoing
summary: Picks an occasional event while a character is running a Study Faith scheme.
details: It only runs if the character is a playable character and is physically able. It sets chance_of_no_event to 50, or 75 for AI characters (the comment says it matters less for AI). Among the entries, an empty one and the travel-details event 1300 have weight 100 each; the others are weight 2 to 6: help from a tutor, spouse or friend, sabotaged notes, offending someone of the faith, gaining cultural acceptance, losing prestige for reading heretical texts, and similar.

label: Study faith succeeded
summary: Handles a successful Study Faith scheme: notifies the puppeteer, and picks a breakthrough or an ending event.
details: The input shows two definitions of this key joined together. One only calls the on_action pam_study_faith_personal_tenet_on_action; the other does the rest. That one calls the notify-puppeteer effect with a good-outcome toast. If the pam DLC trigger passes, the character is a ruler and has a Christian Church situation that lists the study-faith catalyst, it triggers that catalyst. If pending_conversion_to_liege is set, it fires study_faith_outcome.0100 after 2 days. Then it picks between a full-rite breakthrough (1000) and the nothing-left-to-learn ending (1500), weight 100 each.

label: Study scripture failed
summary: Picks an event for a character after a Study Scripture scheme failed.
details: Script fires it and it runs on a character. Vanilla lists eleven events of the study_scripture_outcome group. The small stress toast (weight 1000) is by far the likeliest. The rest are skill gains, an admonishing superior, devotional gifts, redoubling devotions, counsel, a helping companion, doubt, or aid from a monastic order.

label: Study scripture succeeded
summary: Picks a reward event for a character after a Study Scripture scheme succeeded.
details: Script fires it and it runs on a character. Vanilla lists twenty-five events of the study_scripture_outcome group: small piety and experience toasts (the piety one at weight 1400 is the likeliest), becoming a Scholar or Mystic, skill gains, piety with a cleric, teaching others, losing stress, trading prestige for benefits, and some limited by their comments to Catholics, Christians, or mystical tenets.

label: Sun worship desert travel
summary: Rewards a traveller with the sun worship desert pilgrim tenet for being in desert terrain, once per journey.
details: The game's documentation gives it no scope, but its code treats the root as the traveller. If the character has the tenet_sun_worship_desert_pilgrim personal tenet, the current travel location is desert, desert mountains or oasis, and the travel plan has not yet been marked, it marks the plan with a variable and shows a good toast. It gives a minor amount of piety and a minor spiritual fulfillment gain. Vanilla keeps it in its pam DLC folder.

label: Sway failed
summary: Handles a failed Sway scheme: calls the notify-puppeteer effect and picks an event.
details: Script fires it and it runs on a character. It sends a bad-outcome toast through the notify-puppeteer effect. It picks the standard failure (weight 100) most of the time, and rarely (weight 2 each) a diplomatic misunderstanding or the target believing you plot against them.

label: Sway: ongoing
summary: Picks an occasional event while a character is running a Sway scheme.
details: Script fires it and it runs on a character. The entries are an empty one (weight 500), rare events (weight 1 or 2) for a different culture, a complimenting letter, or visiting a vassal or liege, and personal_scheme_ongoing.1000 at weight 1000, which the comment says applies a saved exotic wares modifier from a pilgrimage. That last event outweighs the empty entry, so it is the likeliest pick.

label: Sway succeeded
summary: Handles a successful Sway scheme: calls the notify-puppeteer effect, may grant spiritual fulfillment, and picks an event.
details: It sends a good-outcome toast through the notify-puppeteer effect. The scheme owner with the harmonious society sway tenet flag gets a minor spiritual fulfillment gain if the target is their liege or their vassal or below. Then it picks the standard success (100) or a rarer event (2): a diplomacy duel, a learning duel, or the target warming up. Event 1004 (50) is commented as only triggered from the Persian Struggle.

label: Accept culture task side effects
summary: May cause a random good or bad side effect of the Accept Culture council task.
details: Only if the character has a steward and does not have the had_steward_task_side_effect variable. chance_to_happen is 1 and an empty entry has weight 1000, so most of the time nothing happens. Otherwise it picks one of three bad or three good events of the steward_task group.

label: Bestow royal favor side effects
summary: May cause a random good or bad side effect when a councillor performs the Bestow Royal Favor task.
details: The game's council task fires it monthly. Only if the character does not have the had_chancellor_task_side_effect variable and the councillor is the chancellor or the personnel minister. Most of the time nothing happens (empty entry 1000). Otherwise one of five chancellor_task events: losing opinion with a vassal, a worse vassal contract, stopping a war between vassals, an improved contract, or gaining vassal opinion.

label: Collect taxes side effects
summary: May cause a random good or bad side effect of the Collect Taxes council task.
details: Only if the character has a steward and does not have the had_steward_task_side_effect variable. Most of the time nothing happens. Bad outcomes are four kinds of county corruption (weight 25 each) and a tax argument between tax collector and steward (50). The one good outcome is extra gold (100).

label: Convert task side effects
summary: May cause a random good or bad side effect when the court chaplain works on the Convert task.
details: The game's council task fires it monthly. Only if the character has a court chaplain and does not have the had_court_chaplain_task_side_effect variable. Most of the time nothing happens. Bad events are two kinds of resistance to conversion. Good events improve county opinion, raise development, or raise county levies.

label: Convince de jure side effects
summary: May cause a random good or bad side effect of the Convince De Jure council task.
details: Only if the character has a steward and does not have the had_steward_task_side_effect variable. Most of the time nothing happens. Bad events: the target liege is aware and displeased, or you lose prestige. The good event gains prestige.

label: Develop county side effects
summary: May cause a random good or bad side effect of the Develop County council task.
details: Only if the character does not have the had_steward_task_side_effect variable and the councillor is the steward or the works minister. Most of the time nothing happens. Bad events: lack of workers, lost county opinion, lost county control (how firmly the holder controls the county), or a tax collector trying to raise taxes in a county being developed. Good events: efficient taxation or increased control.

label: Disrupt schemes side effects
summary: May cause a random good or bad side effect of the spymaster's Disrupt Schemes task.
details: Only if the character has a spymaster and does not have the had_spymaster_task_side_effect variable. Most of the time nothing happens. Bad events: the spymaster reveals your secret or a courtier's secret to a powerful vassal. Good events: a hostile scheme is interrupted, or a minor or major secret is discovered.

label: Domestic affairs side effects
summary: May cause a random good or bad side effect when a chancellor or kurultai councillor handles domestic affairs.
details: The game's council tasks fire it monthly. Only if the character has neither the had_chancellor_task_side_effect nor the had_kurultai_task_side_effect variable, and has a chancellor or a kurultai. Most of the time nothing happens (empty entry 1200). It reuses the chancellor_task events: losing vassal opinion, a worse vassal contract, losing crown authority, stopping a war between vassals, an improved contract, gaining vassal opinion, or forcing a vassal into partition succession.

label: Exploit area task
summary: Passes on to the Exploit Area side effects if the character has a kurultai councillor.
details: The game's kurultai council tasks fire it monthly. It only continues if at least one of the four kurultai councillor slots is filled. It then runs task_exploit_area_side_effects, which holds the real events.

label: Exploit area side effects
summary: May cause a random good or bad side effect of the kurultai Exploit Area task.
details: Only if the character does not have the had_kurultai_task_side_effect variable. Most of the time nothing happens. Two bad events (1350, 1355) and two good events (1300, 1305) of the kurultai_task group are possible.

label: Explore cultures task
summary: Passes on to the Explore Cultures side effects if the character has a kurultai councillor.
details: The game's kurultai council tasks fire it monthly. It only continues if at least one of the four kurultai councillor slots is filled. It then runs task_explore_cultures_side_effects, which holds the real events.

label: Explore cultures side effects
summary: May cause a random good or bad side effect of the kurultai Explore Cultures task.
details: Only if the character does not have the had_kurultai_task_side_effect variable. Most of the time nothing happens. Two bad events (1550, 1555) and two good events (1500, 1505) of the kurultai_task group are possible.

label: Fabricate claim side effects
summary: May cause a random bad side effect when a councillor works on the Fabricate Claim task.
details: The game's council task fires it monthly. Only if the character does not have the had_court_chaplain_task_side_effect variable and the councillor is the court chaplain or the justice minister. Most of the time nothing happens. Only bad events exist (the good section is empty): vassals or a powerful vassal dislike it, loss of piety, or the target discovers it.

label: Fabricate claim succeeded
summary: Picks what the fabricated claim is on when the Fabricate Claim task succeeds.
details: It runs on a character; vanilla's council task fires it as an event on_action for the councillor's liege. It picks event 0301 (a claim on a county, weight 100) or 0302 (a claim on a duchy, weight 20), so a county is five times as likely.

label: Find secrets outcome
summary: Picks a result for the spymaster's Find Secrets task.
details: It runs on a character. It picks a minor secret found (weight 100), a major secret found (50), or, rarely (10), the event that fabricates a hook (the comment says it needs Truth is Relative). The comment also says the hook event is fired when no secrets exist. The input does not show when the game fires this one.

label: Find secrets: choose secret
summary: Chooses which kind of secret Find Secrets reveals.
details: It uses first_valid, so it goes through a fixed list and fires the first event whose own conditions are met. The order is deviant, sodomy, murder attempt, murder, cannibal, lover, unbeliever, incest, witch, bastard, target has a bastard, known bastard fatherhood, crypto-religionist, and finally a fallback event.

label: Find secrets side effects
summary: May cause a bad side effect, such as being caught snooping, of the spymaster's Find Secrets task.
details: Only if the character has a spymaster and does not have the had_spymaster_task_side_effect variable. Most of the time nothing happens (empty entry 500). Otherwise one of five equally weighted events: nothing is found, or the spymaster is caught snooping on a vassal, the liege, a foreign ruler, or a foreign ruler's vassal.

label: Foreign affairs side effects
summary: May cause a random good or bad side effect when the chancellor handles foreign affairs.
details: The game's council task fires it monthly. Only if the character has a chancellor and does not have the had_chancellor_task_side_effect variable. Most of the time nothing happens. Bad events: a neighbor gains a claim on you (rare, weight 10), a truce against you is shortened, or a neighbor's opinion drops. Good events: a truce against an enemy is shortened, or a neighbor's opinion rises.

label: Help herders task
summary: Passes on to the Increase Control side effects if the character has a kurultai councillor.
details: The game's kurultai council tasks fire it monthly. It only continues if at least one of the four kurultai councillor slots is filled. It then runs task_increase_control_side_effects, not a side-effects on_action named after this task, so the herders task shares its side effects with the increase control task.
